notes.body: ah damn, let me fix the build

  • 3cefd138 - bitcoin: dissecting segwit transactions (witness fields etc.)
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/12938/diffs?diff_id=832708379&start_sha=a4ace0f0c6ded4ac80d5c460d6a8f2b5b182be57)

Hi,

can you fix

```
* (tshark:13952) 16:45:26.782588 [Epan WARNING] epan/proto.c:9449 -- proto_register_field_init(): 'bitcoin.tx.witness.component_count' exists multiple times with incompatible types: FT_UINT64 and FT_UINT32
 ** (tshark:13952) 16:45:26.782616 [Epan WARNING] epan/proto.c:9449 -- proto_register_field_init(): 'bitcoin.tx.witness.component.length' exists multiple times with incompatible types: FT_UINT64 and FT_UINT32
```

Need to use difference display filter

it is not possible to use proto_tree_add_varint (like packet-quic ?) (may be need to add a new VARINT type)

or look packet-mysql (with tvb_get_fle)
Fixed. I did it the same way it is already done in `packet-bitcoin.c` for other varint fields i.e. suffixing the `FT_UINT64` filter names with `...64`.
Btw, could you share the command (or link to the relevant section in the developer's guide) which I can use to generate a list of these `[Epan WARNING]`s myself?

not really doc, you can look .gitlab-ci.yaml configuration (need to enable CHECK_HFCONFLICT...)

There is also some check tools on tools folder
Ah, thanks. And the `exists multiple times with incompatible types` warning is gone now from what I see.

Could you please also configure an email address and remove the [PATCH] from commit mesage?
```
From 3cefd138d6f4ae77181e20dd6d29cfce3c3c4c40 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: snicket2100 <15079832-snicket2100@users.noreply.gitlab.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Oct 2023 13:43:18 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] bitcoin: dissecting segwit transactions (witness fields etc.)
```
Regarding the `[PATCH]` prefix, are you sure this isn't something added by some kind of git2email gateway you are using? As I don't see it in my commit message.
That's what is in the patch you can download from GitLab, and yes it seesm to be locally added. Sorry for the noise, but there is still a missing email address
Email address also fixed.
